agent.description: The orientation: what the step is for

skills.description: Skills the agent uses, in the order the brief names them

attended.description: Worked with a person; always started by a person

nudges.description: Max nudges in the same session

hand_back.description: Outcome → what its norn done must come with

means.description: Outcome → what it means, shown to the agent in the brief

verdict.description: Outcome → the worst criteria verdict it may be reported with

exits.description: Exit code → outcome; exit 0 is pass, an undeclared one fail

gate.description: What the person decides; shown in inbox

await.description: The signal kinds the step waits on; it takes the first route whose kind is present

grace.description: How long no check reads as pending before ci.none; default 5m
